title: IMPRS-µLife (Marburg Graduate School of Microbiology) PhD call
institution: Max Planck Institute for Terrestrial Microbiology and Philipps-Universität Marburg (IMPRS-µLife)
about: The Marburg Graduate School of Microbiology (IMPRS-µLife) opens its next PhD call on 1 December 2026, closing 31 January 2027, for an October 2027 start in Marburg, Germany. Shortlisted applicants have online interviews in March and a selection symposium in April.
requirements: Master of Science or equivalent in fields such as biology, microbiology or chemistry
Extended four-year Bachelor's may qualify, usually with extra courses at Philipps-Universität Marburg
Applications only via the online portal
